fund_name.quote: Ashgrove Special Situations Fund, L.P. (the "Partnership") is a limited partnership organized under the laws of the State of Delaware on January 19, 2023.

fund_domicile.quote: Ashgrove Special Situations Fund, L.P. (the "Partnership") is a limited partnership organized under the laws of the State of Delaware on January 19, 2023.

fund_structure.quote: The Partnership invests directly and does not operate as a feeder into a master fund.

management_fee.value: 1.60% of the net asset value of each Limited Partner's capital account
management_fee.quote: The Partnership pays the Investment Manager a management fee accrued monthly and payable quarterly in arrears at an annual rate of 1.60% of the net asset value of each Limited Partner's capital account, determined prior to accrual of the Incentive Allocation.

performance_fee.value: 15% of Net New Appreciation for Class F Interests, 20% of Net New Appreciation for Class I Interests
performance_fee.quote: With respect to Class F Interests, the Incentive Allocation is 15% of Net New Appreciation. With respect to Class I Interests, the Incentive Allocation is 20% of Net New Appreciation.

hurdle_rate.value: 4.00% per annum soft hurdle with full catch-up for Class I Interests, NOT_APPLICABLE for Class F Interests
hurdle_rate.quote: With respect to Class I Interests, the Incentive Allocation of 20% of Net New Appreciation is, effective January 1, 2025, subject to a preferred return of 4.00% per annum, calculated on the opening capital account balance for each Incentive Period and adjusted pro rata for subscriptions and redemptions during the period.

high_water_mark.value: Perpetual high water mark on a per-Limited-Partner, per-subscription basis
high_water_mark.quote: The Partnership maintains a perpetual high water mark on a per-Limited-Partner, per-subscription basis.

minimum_initial_investment.quote: The minimum initial subscription for Class I Interests is $1,000,000, and the minimum additional subscription is $100,000.

lockup_period.value: Soft lock-up with 2.00% early redemption charge for redemptions within 18 months of subscription
lockup_period.quote: Interests are not subject to a hard lock-up. Instead, Interests redeemed within eighteen (18) months of the date of the relevant subscription are subject to an early redemption charge of 2.00% of the redemption proceeds, payable to the Partnership for the benefit of remaining Limited Partners.

redemption_frequency.quote: Interests may be redeemed as of the last business day of each calendar quarter.

redemption_notice_days.quote: Written notice of redemption must be received by the Administrator not less than forty-five (45) calendar days prior to the applicable redemption date.

gate_provision.value: Fund-level gate of 25% of the Partnership's net asset value
gate_provision.quote: Fund-level gate | 25% of the Partnership's net asset value as of the applicable redemption date

key_man_provision.quote: the Partnership does not provide any key person provision, key man clause, or associated redemption right.

gp_commitment.quote: The General Partner has not committed, and does not commit, to maintain any minimum investment in the Partnership.

fund_term.quote: The Partnership has a perpetual term and continues until dissolved by the General Partner or as otherwise provided in the Limited Partnership Agreement.

auditor.quote: Effective for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, the Partnership has appointed Wexley Sandoval Partners LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm, replacing Ardmore Pike & Levinson LLP.

administrator.quote: Kestrel Harbour Fund Administration, LLC serves as the Partnership's administrator, responsible for net asset value calculation, capital account maintenance, investor onboarding, and anti-money laundering procedures.

legal_counsel.quote: Farrow Tindall Greaves LLP serves as counsel to the Partnership, the General Partner and the Investment Manager.

mfn_election.quote: The Partnership does not offer a most favored nation election.
